hooks.name: eve-sdl-preflight
hooks.description: On session start, verify SDL prerequisites and print AGENT DIRECTIVES to surface to the user. Logic lives in eve-sdl-preflight.sh (plain sh, no bun) so it fires even when bun is missing; NEVER blocks (SessionStart cannot block — its stdout is injected into agent context). It checks (A) bun + eve are installed and on PATH (the PreToolUse eve-sdl-gate is what hard-blocks if not), and (B) AMAIISDOM credentials for eve's opengrep scanner: a hook has no TTY so eve cannot prompt here, so when no credentials are stored it directs the user to run `eve credentials amaiisdom <username>` THEMSELVES in the terminal, where eve prompts securely and the agent never sees the password (non-blocking — the local secrets scanner still enforces; only opengrep is skipped until creds are set).
